analyticsIntent.title: Analytics Intent
analyticsIntent.description: Per-agent intent catalog used by the chat analytics classifier (Lucene MLT embedded + SE-backed Solr/ES).
analyticsIntent.blankDescription: Create labels with representative user utterances so the classifier can categorise finished conversations.
analyticsIntent.dialogDescription: Label is shown on dashboards; samples are scored against session transcripts. Disabled labels are ignored.
analyticsIntent.samplesHint: One sample per line. The classifier concatenates them as the field MLT scores against.

placeholders.label: e.g. Refund request
placeholders.samples:
I want my money back
refund please
can I get a chargeback
